levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري
أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي» (the compiler's father) and «مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» are co-transmitters («جَمِيعاً»): one level
«أبيه» names Ahmad al-Barqi's father only by relation

the report is the woman's own first-person account: Abu Abdullah (Sadiq) speaks inside it and «الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ فَاطِمَةَ» answers her; the chain as written ends at her, and whether the Imams named inside her account are links is for the ruling (owner rulings 2, rule 11)
